# Coexistence of Authored Footnotes and URL Links

This document demonstrates the coexistence of authored footnotes and automatic link footnotes.

First, here is an inline link to [Golang](https://go.dev).
Next, we reference an authored footnote[^note1].
Then we have a second link to [GitHub](https://github.com/arran4/md2png).
Finally, we have another authored footnote[^note2].

[^note1]: First authored footnote definition with details.
[^note2]: Second authored footnote definition explaining advanced usage.
